The eye: one meaning per icon

Mock over Sky's frame from build 0.2.164. Today one closed eye means four different things, and a robot on a detour isn't blind at all. After this, an open eye means only someone sees you, a closed eye is gone, and a countdown wears the face of what it counts. No new art: every icon here is already in the kit.

  • 1The plate: Sky's "closed eye, 18". It's the robot's reroute clock, see below. Nothing on it says so, and it hangs far from the robot.
  • 2The straight line with a tick at each end: the patrol's normal beat (patrol-a to patrol-b, 15 m).
  • 3The dotted line with arrowheads: the detour. The robot is on the way back to its beat, so both lines run nearly side by side.
  • 4Not asked, not touched: the big turquoise ring is the getaway's 8 m reach round the car (§10).

Whose plate? I fitted the frame to the plan: 15 m of sweep gives 107 px/m at yaw 210, and the peach car lands within 0.2 m of service-drive. The robot stands at about (58, -8), off its beat, so the reroute is in play and reroute:patrol is open; yet no plate sits over the robot, the only plate in the frame is centred within 2 px of the robot's x, and the robot has about 13.5 m left at 0.85 m/s, about 16 s. So it's the robot's, placed about 1,200 px too high. Two things I can't explain from code alone: a 115 s window should print 0:18 not 18 (its bar at 32 % implies a 56 s span), and only ClearOfSpeech can lift a plate, with no bubble in the crop. Latch can settle both by logging WindowWords, the anchor and the plate's top in this state. The guard's window is the only other candidate that prints plain seconds; no guard stands under the plate.

The language

SignMeans onlyWhere the rule comes from
open eye, red in the worldSomeone sees you, or would. Price line, door, move ring, the eye over a watcher, the fail camera.Starting idea kept. The move ring already works this way: no eye unless seen.
eye with ?Might be seen: you haven't watched yet. Same question, unanswered.T10 "will that walk be seen?"
no eye at allUnseen. The price line already drops every field that's zero; Alt still says "Unseen".Decision 1. A closed eye is retired everywhere.
face + count + bar + tailThis thing is out of your way until 0, then it's back. Robot, guard, camera, rivals.Readable > rich: names the thing, not a state of mind. Being watched reads through cones and rings.
siren + count + bar + tailAn alarm lands at 0. Only the desk's clock; the siren already means Alert on the price line.Glyph 058 §3, unchanged.
a line on the groundOne at a time, only while you look. Hover the robot: its beat, or its detour if one is running. Hover the Reroute way: the detour and where it stops.Sky: "what are the straight and dotted lines". Two at once was the failure.

Same 38 px plate as today, so the HUD budget doesn't move. New: the tail the art bible already specifies (18 x 11 px) and plain seconds under a minute everywhere (today the same clock reads 18 or 0:18 depending on the window's length). Hover lines are one plain line, like the eye's tip today, and only when asked for. Colours come from existing kit sprites and the plate's own turquoise and amber. Colours and fit here are a browser's rendering of the sprites; Latch's build gets my 2x crop check.

Add the tail, and count it in HudToolkit.Hold.cs:67. Anchor the patrol at 1.7 m, not a person's 2.45. WindowCount: plain seconds whenever left < 60. Plates pickable, with a tip. Find and fix why the plate left the robot (log first).
  • HostDone.cs: lines 306-307 and 404 as in the table; a WindowLine(mark) for the hover words. WindowsRead: its span counts from the first read, so a window read late gets a short Total; check this against the 56 s.
  • HostReroute.cs + HudToolkit.Reroute.cs: keep On, Live and Route as they are (the proof reads them). Add Draw = hovering the robot, its plate or the way, and not g.FightOn. Sweep only when no detour is in play and the way isn't hovered; route only otherwise.

  • HandoverHost.cs:361, HudToolkit.cs:572, Briefing.cs:172, HudToolkit.Attention.cs:230, HostSeal.cs:45: as in the table.
  • contracts/missions/handover/text.json (Fable): the five hover lines; the eye field's note. eye_shut@2x.png stays in the kit, unused. After Sky's yes, GDD §10 line "eye (open, shut or ?)" and the art bible's window marker line (Aster, a new version).

Two decisions for Sky

1. What does "unseen" look like on an order's price? The closed eye also said "nobody will see this". Recommended: nothing, as with every zero on the price line and as the move ring does already; Alt says "Unseen". The other way is a small plain tick, which is one more icon to learn and adds a mark to nearly every order.
2. Should the detour stay drawn while it runs? On 24 Oct Sky asked to "see the new route when it's in play"; today he asked what the lines are. Recommended: hover only (robot, plate or Reroute way), with the plate carrying the time at rest. The other way keeps the dotted route alone drawn during play, and drops only the straight line.
